name: How much does interior ceiling painting cost in Denver?
description: Costs vary, but Denver interior painting often runs about $4–$8 per square foot, with smooth ceilings sometimes around $3–$5 per square foot.

mainEntity.name: How much does interior ceiling painting cost in Denver?

acceptedAnswer.text: In Denver, interior painting commonly runs about **$4 to $8 per square foot**, and smooth ceilings may fall around **$3 to $5 per square foot** depending on the condition and prep required. Ceiling height, repairs, and how much masking is needed can push the price up.
